01 / ABOUT ME

An architect’s eye.
A builder’s mindset.

My journey began in architecture in India, developing residential, commercial, and interior projects. Over five years, my work grew beyond drawings into site coordination, material procurement, cost estimating, and hands-on project execution.

Today, I’m pursuing my M.S. in Construction Management & Technology at Arizona State University. I’m bringing that field experience into a new chapter—exploring BIM, digital twins, and AI in construction to connect better design with better delivery.
